description: This file defines exported functions related to COSA bus utilities, including parameter retrieval and interface address functions, for the Cosa Data Model Agent component.

methods.name: CosaGetParamValueUlong
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned long parameter value given its name.

methods.name: CosaGetParamValueString
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value given its name, buffer, and size.

methods.name: CosaGetInstanceNumberByIndex
methods.description: Gets the instance number of an object given its name and index.

methods.name: CosaGetInterfaceAddrByName
methods.description: Returns the interface address associated with a given interface name.

methods.name: CosaGetRegistryRootFolder
methods.description: Provides access to the registry root folder object.
